_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: The day is far spent, and the road has been long.
Stay with us, Lord; the evening is near.
A stranger walked with us and opened the Scriptures.
And our hearts burned within us.
He took the bread, blessed and broke it, and we knew him.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
Come, let us worship the Lord made known in the breaking of bread.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Come in off the road as the light goes long and gold, road-weary, heavy with all you cannot explain.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
A stranger fell into step beside you and turned the old story over until your chest went warm.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
Then he sat at your table, took the loaf, and broke it — and you saw the marks, and you knew.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
On the mountain God spreads a feast and swallows up death forever; come and taste it now.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: Evening falls; the road has worn us thin.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
He opens the Scriptures, and our hearts catch fire.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
He breaks the bread, and our eyes are opened.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
Come, let us know him at the table.
We have seen the Lord. Alleluia!
